en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a formal complex of large institutional buildings behind a fence and a railway line in the foreground. On the left is a small neoclassical gatehouse with four columns and a pediment bearing a decorative crest. To the right stretches a long, multi‑storey building with steep tiled roofs, dormer windows, and a central tower with a clock or cupola. The scene is taken from across the railway tracks under a sky with scattered clouds.
